description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Finds a site's sitemaps (robots.txt Sitemap lines, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, or a sitemap URL you give), follows sitemap indexes (up to 6 files) and returns up to 1000 page URLs with lastmod, plus per-sitemap status. Cached 1 h. ~0.5-4 s.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

title: Sitemap URL extractor (robots.txt + sitemap index)
